body.title: Fix ScenarioRun Duration Tracking in SwarmAdapter
body.body: Currently, ScenarioRun duration is hardcoded to 0.0 in SwarmAdapter, which does not reflect the actual runtime of the scenario. This PR updates SwarmAdapter.end_session to: Use the already-calculated duration_seconds metric. Convert it to milliseconds. Populate the duration_ms field in ScenarioRun. This ensures that scenario durations are accurately recorded, improving metrics tracking and reporting consistency.
